seeded_payload.research_rationale: EO 11948 (December 20, 1976, effective December 31, 1976) continued thirteen advisory committees until December 31, 1978 (sec. 1(a)-(m)), assigned the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for them to the listed agency heads (sec. 2), revoked EO 11868 effective January 16, 1977 (sec. 3), revoked EOs 11667, 11809 and 11860 and superseded EO 11827 (sec. 4). Earlier partial ends found by reading the acting texts: EO 12110 (December 31, 1978) terminated the Citizens' Advisory Council on the Status of Women, the Citizens' Advisory Committee on Environmental Quality, the Advisory Council for Minority Enterprise and the Consumer Advisory Council and in sec. 6 superseded subsections (a), (g), (i) and (j) of sec. 1; EO 12029 (December 14, 1977) terminated the Quetico-Superior Committee and in sec. 2 superseded subsection (e). Neither states an effective date, so each took effect on signing. The remaining continuances ran 'until December 31, 1978', the same day EO 12110 (signed December 28, 1978) took effect under its sec. 1-105 and superseded this order (sec. 1-104); sec. 2 ended then too. Secs. 3, 4 and 5 were one-time acts complete on January 16, 1977 and December 31, 1976. The 1989 Codification disposition table and the OFR catalog note were used as leads only; the dates come from the order texts, checked against the text layer of the saved official FR scans (no page-image comparison). Whole-order end 1978-12-31.
